+

+

+print(text)
+print()
+

+print("Applying pre-processors:")
+for pp in [pre_processors.tone_marks, pre_processors.end_of_line, pre_processors.abbreviations, pre_processors.word_sub]:

+    print(f"After {pp.__name__}:")
+    print(text)
+    print()
